name: zinterp_context_pop_file_frame
description: zInterp_Context::PopFileFrame returns the top saved file frame after decrementing the frame count, or null when the stack is empty.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1940 validates the fileFrameCount load at context offset 0xa0, null return for an empty stack, decrement/store, fileFrameStack load at offset 0x9c, 0x0c-byte frame indexing, and returned top-frame pointer.
The native smoke verifies two LIFO pops return the expected frame addresses and decrement fileFrameCount, followed by a null return once the stack is empty.
